_comment: Placed at the host project root as traceconfig.json. Read by .claude/tools/trace-check. The orchestrator seeds it once; the host edits source/tests/layering to match its own layout. Omit the contract block when the implementation has no single error-code source (C7 then skips). The schema block names the DB design's native source (migrations / schema.prisma / model files); omit it when the app owns no persisted data (C13 then skips). implements_pattern's capture 1 may be a list (`@implements UC-001, REQ-009 / BR-015`); trace-check splits it on , or /. tests.test_pattern marks a test function (one regex per line); with it set, C11 also reports tests that carry no @covers at all, except those preceded by tests.exempt_pattern (an explicit out-of-spec marker) — omit both to skip that check. layering.layer_pattern says which path level under layering.root names the layer: "{layer}" (default) is the first level, "*/{layer}" the second (Features/<name>/Domain), * matching any one directory.
